en:
<CLT=cltMIND>These monitors are everywhere,
but I don't see any cameras.

<CLT=cltMIND>How is the mastermind behind this
killing game monitoring us?

<CLT=cltMIND>Or...are we not really
being watched at all?

<CLT=cltMIND>After the third class trial, we've lost seven
friends. Only nine of us are left.

<CLT=cltMIND>But we've all taken Himiko and Tenko's wish
to heart. We're trying to live on.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki also decided to join us,
help us to survive.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps it's only a little bit,
but we're closer to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>end<CLT=cltMIND>...
